description: Month-by-month price movement for a category of UK components, base 100 at the start of the series. Use to answer whether prices in a category are rising or falling. This describes a category, not an individual product: for one product use get_price_verdict. lastComputedAt says how fresh the answer is.

category.description: Category to read, e.g. "ram" or "gpu". Defaults to "all", the whole-catalogue series. The response lists availableCategories.

name: get_price_index
title: Read the component price index
